blurb: The only place history is read. Rows read like git log --oneline.
reasons: Why commit diff shop/api agent: "what did this Branch change?" is the common question, so one argument answers it. --from names the other side when it is not the fork point or the parent.
Why the Store resolves prefixes: today commit.get pages history on the caller's side, about 21 Store calls for 1000 Commits.
Why paths by default: a diff of 100 paths is ~25 KB today. Most callers ask what changed; --with patch answers how.
Why two different paths cannot be compared: file.diff could. The files view compares one path between two Commits, which commit diff --path covers.

calls.note: + branch.commits; newest first; on main the rows are its publications, each with the source_branch it came from and no message; a message is cut at 128 characters (message_truncated); --at starts at an older Commit (today's at_commit); the long row always carries the byte counts, so include_storage is gone; via is workspace, file, merge, publish or init

calls.new_work: One list in place of two: today `commit.list` pages by position and answers whole Commit records, and `branch.commits` pages by number from a pinned start and answers summaries. `--cursor` is new: today the call pages by position (`page_size`, `page_pos`, default 50). The cursor must carry the Commit the first page read and the call's filters. An id prefix is new: today the call takes a full 66-character id.

calls.new_work: Finding a Commit without a Branch is new: today both calls need one. `commit.get` matches an id or prefix by paging that Branch's Commits on the caller's side, about 21 Store calls for 1000 Commits; `branch.get_commit` takes full ids only. Resolving an id or prefix in the Store, in one call, is new.

calls.note: + branch.diff, file.diff; ref is a Branch or a Commit; without --from: the changes since the fork (a Branch) or since the parent (a Commit); paths only by default, --with patch adds each text file's lines; --path narrows to one file or one folder; change is added, removed or modified; comparing two different paths and line ownership across a diff are dropped
calls.help: the paths that differ between two Commits or Branches

calls.new_work: `<ref>` alone is new: finding the fork point of a Branch or the parent of a Commit as the other side (today both sides are always given). One argument that is a Branch or a Commit is new: today `commit.diff` takes two full ids and `branch.diff` two Branch names with optional Commits. `--path` exists only on `branch.diff` today (`path_prefix`). Paths-only is today's `paths_only`; it becomes the default. `--cursor` exists today as the last path an earlier page listed (beside `page_pos`, and `continuation` on `branch.diff`); it becomes one opaque cursor that carries both pinned Commits and the filters. An id prefix is new: today the call takes a full 66-character id.
